decisions.reason: Requiring the correct sensor-board BOM does not change the component-sourceability policy; the resistor-package standardization clause is an unresolved question rather than a confirmed change.
Correcting the sensor-board BOM does not alter the existing obligation to assist with manufacturer order setup.
The sensor-board BOM correction does not change whether the KiCad project is portable or resolves local-library footprints.
Generating the correct sensor-board BOM does not change the required SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The BOM-file correction leaves the interboard connector types, pinouts, and power topology unchanged.
The source requests a correct manufacturing BOM but does not modify the sensor-board connector inventory, pinouts, or module interfaces.
The sensor-board BOM requirement does not change the ESP32 breakout requirement; the separate breakout uncertainty in the same message is already represented by its AMBIGUOUS Event.
The sensor-board BOM correction does not alter any main-board dimensions, placement, orientation, or connector-access constraints.
The BOM correction does not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, or measurement coverage; the shunt-package question does not establish a functional monitoring change.
Generating the correct sensor-board BOM does not modify the board's mounting, connector placement, orientation, or enclosure-integration constraints.
The sensor-board BOM correction does not change the established 3.3V logic policy or the omission of the on-board level shifter.
The BOM-file correction does not affect the DCDC1 output setting, target rail voltage, or compensation requirement.
